Железо.about: Hemoglobin cofactor: works for anemia and ferritin deficiency; at normal levels there is no benefit.
Железо.caution: The effect depends on the INITIAL ferritin level. Healthy people with normal Fe have little benefit. In case of anemia or deficiency - significant. GI side effects (constipation, nausea) are frequent. Pregnancy: WHO routine recommendation.
Железо.food_sources: Red meat (heme - better absorbed); vegetable and tannins (tea) are worse. You can't get enough food if there's a shortage.
Железо.guidelines: WHO - routine during pregnancy; in case of deficiency, courses and under the control of ferritin. Cochrane: anemia RR 0.30 (0.20–0.47).
Железо.how_to_choose: Start with ferritin/OAC only. Don’t push the form: choose the one that is tolerable - GI side effects decide.
mechs: Heme/ferritin: O2 transport; tyrosine hydroxylase cofactor
Replenishment of hemoglobin and ferritin in case of deficiency/anemia
Anemia during pregnancy: RR 0.30 (0.20–0.47); Ferritin is normal

Железо.myths: “More - more energetic” - there is no benefit at normal ferritin levels. “Only daily” - 1–3 r/week softer. “Tea cancels everything” - it only reduces absorption.

Железо.onset: Ferritin and hemoglobin increase over 4–12 weeks; the 1–3 r/week scheme is gentler on GI.
